parent_population: All 1137 S2 signals from parent B0 bank, including rejected/unresolved parent entries; never select by parent profit or fill status
question: Can next-day price acceptance and continued volume separate sustained recovery from failed rebound, after controlling for delayed entry?
information_window: Inherited 3/5/10/15-day features and <=18-day base memory, plus at most two subsequent observed confirmation sessions; no RPS
price_confirmation_1: At t+1 close: adjusted close>=signal close AND adjusted low>=signal low AND close location within own high-low>=0.5; require next consecutive market bar and positive observed volume
volume_confirmation_1: price_confirmation_1 AND volume[t+1]>=mean(volume[t-9:t+1]), i.e. preceding 10 stock bars excluding confirmation bar
price_confirmation_2: Both t+1 and t+2 pass close>=signal close, low>=signal low, own close location>=0.5; additionally close[t+2]>=close[t+1]
volume_confirmation_2: price_confirmation_2 AND both confirmation-day volumes >= each day's own preceding10 mean

arms.D0: No confirmation; enter t+1 open, corrected engine; timing reference only
arms.W1: Wait through t+1, no price/volume selection; enter t+2 open
arms.P1: Same t+2 entry as W1, require price_confirmation_1
arms.V1: Same t+2 entry as W1, require volume_confirmation_1
arms.W2: Wait through t+2, no price/volume selection; enter t+3 open
arms.P2: Same t+3 entry as W2, require price_confirmation_2
arms.V2: Same t+3 entry as W2, require volume_confirmation_2

entry_engine_correction: Only next opening print and prior known raw/factor reference may reject indicative limit-up entry. Do NOT inspect entry-day high==low to decide an opening order; old v1 is preserved and not relabeled.
exit: Fixed horizon close, no same-day resale; reject indicative limit-down close and roll <=5 extra market sessions; no future tail forced liquidation. No dynamic stop rule added.
indicative_limit: 10% ordinary, 20% STAR/ChiNext, 0.3pp tolerance; historic ST/IPO/special constraints still unverified
evaluation: Report all time slices, filtered/censored/rejected rows, median adverse excursion, date-equal results, same-delay accepted-vs-rejected differences and month-block uncertainty. No optimized thresholds.
bounds: A-share historical ST, IPO and complete delisting universe remain unavailable; not portfolio approval
Confirmation is known only after its daily close; never enter on that same open or same close
All parent historical windows have prior research exposure; not untouched out-of-sample
40/80bp are proportional hypothetical costs, not full taxes/commissions/impact
Use only unchanged raw TDX source files and frozen parent factors; report changed files as blocked instead of refreshing silently
Selecting S2 after prior results is itself exploratory selection; month-block intervals do not remove this or multiple comparisons
No modification to production strategies, raw data, original event banks, personal holdings or remote systems
